beyond_dusky_skies: Cyril "Mole" Skies signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F17 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Arno Toastyy and Cyril "Mole" Skies carried a kettle through three narrow traverses without spilling a drop. Applause at the destination caused the accident.

A man asked Cyril "Mole" Skies to describe Northwick without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Cyril "Mole" Skies watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony spotted Henrik Hunted of the Concord repairing a parapet at the Drowned Farm. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Cyril "Mole" Skies traded a book with the last pages torn out for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
Cyril "Mole" Skies fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Quentin "Shadow" Danny, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
franek.szymanski.376: Felix Szymanski arrived at S-F7 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.
Felix Szymanski of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Isidor Jackmdunn kept the tin.
Felix Szymanski caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.

Felix Szymanski's transfer to the role of machine gunner was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Felix Szymanski watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Felix Szymanski fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Felix "Tin" Singh, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.

A direct hit on the trench at S-F7. Felix Szymanski was the only one they could still help, and only just. A shell landed square in the trench at S-F7. Felix Szymanski was killed outright. The bearers found nothing to carry.

Isidor "Brick" Szymanski arrived carrying the family name of Felix Szymanski. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. Isidor "Brick" Szymanski transferred to the machine gunners. The men in S-F7 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet found Isidor "Brick" Szymanski at S-F7, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Mail came up the line with a letter for Isidor "Brick" Szymanski. Isidor "Brick" Szymanski read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
javimty97: Nobody asked Emil "Mud" Javimty why he came. Nobody in R-F9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Emil "Mud" Javimty is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Emil "Mud" Javimty finished a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.

Emil "Mud" Javimty lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified. On Day 3, Verdel Ridge passed to the Concord. Emil "Mud" Javimty wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Emil "Mud" Javimty wrote a letter for Anselm "Parson" Rock's mother, because Parson could not find the words. Parson signed it.

Emil "Mud" Javimty's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. A letter from home reached Emil "Mud" Javimty before dusk. Emil "Mud" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil "Mud" Javimty spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at R-F9 is closed now. A letter from home reached Emil "Mud" Javimty before dusk. Emil "Mud" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.
